messages:
Samir Rao: FYI - Everguard Bank reached out asking about swapping out their current provider (GiantAPI) for Redwood. Primary asks: parity for compliance flows, proof of no-data-leak with KMS/HSM, and a transitional pricing model. Can we scope a presales plan?
Eve Park: Key numbers: they do ~5M tokens/day, peaking at 6k concurrent sessions. Their compliance flows include 15 high-sensitivity prompts that must be identical to current provider output. They want a 6-week POC.
Diego L.: For exact parity on 15 prompts we'll need request/response captures and the exact post-processing rules they apply client-side. Any idea how strict "identical" is (byte-for-byte vs. deterministic semantics)?
Eve Park: They said "byte-for-byte for the 15 prompts, semantic for the rest." Also they currently use streaming=false and a custom 'conversation_state' header.
Hannah Y.: Migration risks: tokenizer mismatch, different default stopping behavior, and subtle detokenization whitespace. We should build a small compatibility shim + a token-diff tool.
Tom K.: On infra: Everguard requires FIPS 140-2 certified key storage and monthly audit bundles for 5 years. They also asked if we can route keys to their AWS KMS under a customer-managed key in Hosted mode.
Samir Rao: Yes we can offer tenant-managed CMK for Hosted and PKCS#11-backed HSM in Private. Need security to confirm FIPS wording.
legal-bot: Reminder: If customer requests dual-provider fallback clause, attach fallback limits and breach notification SLA. Legal review required for any hybrid billing clause.
Diego L.: Operational plan suggestion: week 0 - ingest 200 sample chats + 15 golden prompts; week 1-2 - run parity harness and iterate shim; week 3 - customer validation; week 4 - canary at 10% traffic; week 5 - 50%; week 6 - go-live or extend.
Eve Park: They asked about cost during hybrid months: they want blended price close to their current flat contract. Sales wants to know if we can do a temporary margin-phased discount for 3 months.
Tom K.: Finance can model a blended rate: use actual token consumption from their logs. We need sanitized usage logs to produce a quote.
Hannah Y.: Engineering asks: what model family are they using on GiantAPI? That affects quantization and reproducing logits.
Eve Park: They use "giant-llm-s2" with temperature 0.0 for compliance flows and 0.2 for generative. They also rely on a function_call schema to extract structured entities.
Diego L.: Function calling wire format differences: we can support a compat flag that maps our function_call response into Giant's schema. That + deterministic sampling should handle most parity cases.
Samir Rao: Action items: 1) Ask Everguard to upload 15 golden prompts + 100 sample conversations + their post-processing rules to our secure bucket. 2) Eng to run parity harness and deliver token-diff + suggested shim. 3) Security to provide KMS/HSM options and required artifacts. 4) Sales/Finance to prepare blended 3-month transition quote. 5) Legal to draft fallback clause.
Eve Park: I'll request the artifacts and schedule the PoC kickoff next Tue 10am ET. Also asking them to mark any prompts that are PII/PIA so we can treat differently.
Tom K.: For KMS docs I'll attach SOC2 cert, last pentest date, and our KMS integration guide. We support AWS KMS CMKs and BYO-HSM via PKCS#11 in Private.
Diego L.: I'll prototype a token-normalizer and compat_mode=giant_s2. Example snippet to test deterministic path:
```
// compat shim prototype
const tokens = giantTokenizer(prompt);
const resp = await redwood.generate({ model: 'rw-compat-s2', input: tokens, temperature: 0, top_p: 1.0, seed: 42 });
return giantDetokenize(resp.tokens);
```
Hannah Y.: Also watch for user's client-side normalization. Add a regression test that replays their exact request/headers.
legal-bot: Note - include language for billing credits if we cause regressions on the 15 golden prompts post-cutover. Legal wants escalation playbook.
Samir Rao: Can someone own the delta report delivery? Need it before the PoC call.
Diego L.: I'll run the harness as soon as we get the CSV and sanitized logs. Will aim to post a short delta report (< 1 business day) and a follow-up with shim code.
Eve Park: Scheduling: PoC kickoff Tue 10am ET, parity report due Mon prior COB, pricing draft Tue morning.
deploy-bot: ci:parity-harness triggered by diego - build #731 (https://ci.redwood.ai/731)
Tom K.: I'll start the security artifact packet and ping Everguard for their compliance point of contact.
Samir Rao: Great. Keep this thread updated. If any blocker is >48h call it out and we'll escalate. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
